candidates: When configuring the Shiki syntax-highlighting theme in the VitePress config (`packages/mermaid/src/docs/.vitepress/config.ts`), always use the dual-mode object form `{ light: '<light-theme>', dark: '<dark-theme>' }` instead of a single theme string. A single string will break code-block highlighting in whichever color mode it was not chosen for, since the site supports both light and dark modes.
